historical_references.reference: Hetal was a renowned queen of the Chalukya Dynasty, known for her beauty and wisdom. She ruled the Chalukya empire during the late 11th century CE, after the death of her husband, King Vikramaditya VI.

Another Hetal is mentioned in the 11th-century Indian epic poem, the 'Mahabharata', as a devoted wife and sister. She was married to Bhima, the strongest of the five Pandava brothers, and helped them during their exile and in the great battle of Kurukshetra.
